what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at Town Hall; also on Zoom (https://us02web.zzoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=82935305945, Meeting ID 909 174 0347, phone (888) 475-4499), and broadcast on Lunenburg Public Access, Facebook Live and YouTube.

items.agenda_line: Update on Food Pantry Relocation and License Agreement
items.why_it_matters: The board will hear an update on moving the food pantry and on the license agreement for its new space, which affects a service residents use.

items.agenda_line: Vote to Waive Technology Fees for Site Plan Application at 1625 Massachusetts Avenue
items.why_it_matters: The board may vote to waive town technology fees for one site plan application, which is a decision on fees.

items.agenda_line: Ratification of the Town Manager’s Appointment of Kat Lemur as Videographer
items.why_it_matters: The board is asked to ratify a town staff appointment for the videographer role.

items.agenda_line: Appoint Select Board Member to Americans with Disabilities Committee
items.why_it_matters: The board may name one of its members to the Americans with Disabilities Committee.
The board will work through chapters 7-12 of the Boards, Committees, Commissions Handbook.
The board will discuss preparations for the Special Town Meeting, including a consent calendar, ahead of the November 17 meeting at the Middle/High School Auditorium.
The board will discuss the town's municipal buildings; the agenda gives no further detail.
The board will take up a modified policy on flags.

preview.hook: Food pantry relocation and license agreement, a technology-fee waiver for 1625 Mass Ave, and a new videographer
preview.one_line: Select Board, Nov 10, 7 PM: food pantry relocation and license agreement, a technology-fee waiver for 1625 Mass Ave, and ratifying the videographer appointment.
